summary: A discussion of how people can write down X.400 originator/recipient (O/R) names in a uniform, human-friendly way. X.400 is the OSI email system, and its addresses are made of several named parts. This informational memo proposes a common way to write them.

eli5.summary: Mail addresses in one old email system had many pieces. This note suggests one tidy way to write them so everyone spells them the same.
